deliverables: Upgrade Cardano mainnet protocol from major version 10 minor 0 to major version 11 minor 0.
Keep the ledger in the Conway era with unchanged transaction shape.
Enable new Plutus primitives from CIP-0109, CIP-0132, CIP-0133, CIP-0138, and CIP-0153.
Make all Plutus built-in functions available consistently across Plutus V1, V2, and V3.
Add UPLC case expressions for Bool, Integer, and Data.
Promote or tighten several ledger and node validation, diagnostic, and security rules.
request.what: Initiate an intra-era Cardano mainnet hard fork to Protocol Version 11.0, named the van Rossem hard fork.

claims.claim: The action would upgrade Cardano mainnet from protocol version 10.0 to 11.0 while remaining in the Conway era.
The proposal says the upgrade adds new Plutus primitives defined in CIP-0109, CIP-0132, CIP-0133, CIP-0138, and CIP-0153.
The proposal says all Plutus built-ins will become available across Plutus V1, V2, and V3, expanding capabilities of existing V1 and V2 scripts.
The proposal says UPLC case expressions for Bool, Integer, and Data will improve performance and simplify script logic.
The proposal says transaction shape is unchanged and ecosystem upgrade effort is minimized because this is an intra-era hard fork.
The proposal says testing reports demonstrate no behavioral regressions, complete specification-implementation conformance for new ledger rules, and correct operation of new Plutus features.
The proposal links a Cardano Node 11.0.1 performance report and says it shows no regressions in standard value, Plutus, and voting benchmarks.
The proposal says security audits were undertaken for Plutus BLS primitives and execution costs for all Plutus primitives.

The proposal says at least 85% of stake pools by active stake should have upgraded to a node version capable of protocol version 11 before ratification, and that this status still needs to be determined.

The proposal states that reversion is only possible in extreme circumstances through the CIP-0135 disaster recovery process, while Plutus primitive usage could be disabled through companion cost model settings if issues are discovered.

summary: The document proposes a no-treasury intra-era hard fork to Cardano protocol version 11.0 with Plutus, ledger, node diagnostic, and security changes, supported by CIP references and a performance report but with several important readiness, testing, audit, and migration assertions stated at a high level.
